what_happened: check_mistakes reads from chronicle/learnings (27 entries) and matches by splitting the applies_to field by spaces, then checking if ANY single word appears in the context. Multi-word applies_to values like infrastructure port configuration only match on individual words. Most topic queries return nothing because the keyword matching is too rigid and the learnings store is anemic compared to insights (27 vs 151).
what_learned: Keyword matching on structured fields breaks when values are multi-word phrases. Content-level text search (like the recall_insights fix) is always more robust than field-level keyword splitting. When a tool consistently returns empty for real queries, the bug is in the matching logic not the data store. Audit by checking: does the store have data? Yes. Does the tool find it? No. Then the retrieval path is broken.
